name: calendar_agent
description: A calendar and scheduling agent backed by Firestore for persistent storage. Manages events, checks availability, and finds free time slots.

skills.name: List Events
skills.description: List calendar events with optional date filtering. Supports specific dates and date ranges.

skills.name: Search Events
skills.description: Search calendar events by text query across titles and descriptions.

skills.name: Create Event
skills.description: Create a new calendar event with title, date, start/end time, attendees, and description.
examples: Schedule a meeting with Ankit tomorrow at 2pm
Create a 1-hour design review on Friday at 11am

skills.name: Update Event
skills.description: Update an existing calendar event's details by event_id. Supports partial updates.
examples: Add Meera to tomorrow's design review

skills.name: Delete Event
skills.description: Delete a calendar event by its event_id.

skills.name: Find Free Slots
skills.description: Find available time slots on a given date within 09:00-17:00 work hours.
examples: Find a 1-hour slot this week for a review
Check availability for a team meeting
